purpose: One-page direction of the project: the goal, the fixed date, the periods, the building blocks and the rule for new ideas.
details: Referenced from CLAUDE.md. The father decides; the page is adjusted at the end of each period. Two equal goals taken in turns (the son, and the product for all Flemish children), the fixed date 1 September 2027 (6th school year, levels shift), a periods table, why the order is mixed practice -> exams -> daily task, and the rule that a bug the child notices is fixed at once, an idea that fits the period is queued, everything else is parked in docs/todo.md.
summary: Direction page. Goal: two equally weighted goals in turns (the son's needs and not forgetting; a free product for Flemish children). Fixed date: 1 September 2027. A table of periods (until Nov 2026: stop lock, mixed practice, then maths frozen apart from bugs). Building blocks: Gemengd oefenen then Examens then Dagtaak. Rule for new ideas: child-visible bug = now, fits the period = in line, the rest = parked in todo.md.
